# LinkedIn Draft - 2026-09-21

n8n 2.39.9, released September 21 and marked latest, fixes HTTP 405 responses from the public credential PATCH endpoint and removes workflow triggers when publication encounters an unavailable node type. These changes matter if credential automation is failing or a publication failure can leave triggers behind. Check whether either path affects your instance, then verify both behaviors in staging before upgrading; the release notes were read, but the fixes were not runtime-tested here.
